comment: Whether customers can ship a single order to multiple addresses.
modal: When **Yes**, customers can split an order across several shipping addresses during checkout; when **No**, each order ships to one address. Can be set per website.

comment: The maximum item quantity allowed when shipping to multiple addresses.
modal: Caps the total quantity of items a customer may ship across multiple addresses in one order. Applies only when **Allow Shipping to Multiple Addresses** is set to Yes. Can be set per website.
